## 2. Product Vision

**Vision:** Every creator publishes with confidence, knowing exactly how their content will perform.

**Mission:** Build the world's most accurate content intelligence platform that predicts engagement before publishing and guides creators to their best work.

**Elevator pitch:** Signal OS is like a spell-checker for content performance. Paste your draft, get an instant score, and publish knowing your content is optimized.

---

## 3. User Personas

### 3.1 Primary: The Growth Creator (Sarah)
- **Demographics:** 25-35, 50K-500K followers
- **Goals:** Grow audience, increase engagement, monetize content
- **Pain points:** Posts flop without explanation, no time to A/B test, intuition failing at scale
- **Tech savvy:** High, uses 3-5 creator tools daily
- **Willingness to pay:** $29-49/month for proven ROI
- **Quote:** *"I need to know WHY my post failed, not just that it did."*

### 3.2 Secondary: The Brand Manager (Marcus)
- **Demographics:** 30-45, manages brand X accounts
- **Goals:** Consistent brand performance, team efficiency, reporting
- **Pain points:** No unified workflow, manual reporting, subjective quality assessment
- **Tech savvy:** Medium, prefers integrated solutions
- **Willingness to pay:** $79-199/month per team
- **Quote:** *"I manage 12 accounts. I need one tool that does it all."*

### 3.3 Tertiary: The Aspiring Creator (Alex)
- **Demographics:** 18-25, <50K followers, growing
- **Goals:** Learn what works, build consistent habits, grow to 100K
- **Pain points:** Don't know best practices, overwhelmed by advice, inconsistent results
- **Tech savvy:** High, mobile-first
- **Willingness to pay:** Free tier, upgrade when earning
- **Quote:** *"I just want someone to tell me if my tweet is good or not."*

---

## 4. Feature Requirements (7 Features)

### 4.1 Real-Time Content Scoring (P0 — MVP)

**User Story:** As a creator, I want to paste my draft and get an instant score so I can improve it before publishing.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] User can paste text up to 280 characters
- [ ] System returns overall score (0-100) within 3 seconds
- [ ] System returns 8 dimension scores with descriptions
- [ ] System provides 3-5 actionable suggestions
- [ ] Scores persist in history for future reference
- [ ] Free users: 5 scores/day, Pro: unlimited

**MoSCoW:** Must

---

### 4.2 Sentiment Analysis Dashboard (P0 — v1.1)

**User Story:** As a creator, I want to understand the emotional tone of my content and audience reactions so I can calibrate my messaging.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Real-time sentiment detection (positive, negative, neutral, mixed)
- [ ] Emotion breakdown (joy, anger, sadness, fear, surprise)
- [ ] Sentiment timeline showing trends over time
- [ ] Comparison with audience sentiment on same topics
- [ ] Exportable reports

**MoSCoW:** Must

---

### 4.3 Trend Forecasting (P0 — v1.2)

**User Story:** As a creator, I want to know which topics are about to trend so I can publish first and capture maximum attention.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Display currently trending topics by category
- [ ] Show 72-hour trend predictions with confidence scores
- [ ] Topic velocity and acceleration metrics
- [ ] Personalized recommendations based on creator niche
- [ ] Alert system for emerging trends in user's domain

**MoSCoW:** Must

---

### 4.4 Command Center v2 (P0 — v1.2)

**User Story:** As a creator, I want a unified workspace to score, schedule, and publish content without switching between tools.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Content queue with drag-and-drop reordering
- [ ] One-click publish to X with OAuth
- [ ] Schedule posts with optimal timing suggestions
- [ ] Calendar view of scheduled content
- [ ] Post autopsy comparing predicted vs actual performance
- [ ] Team collaboration (comments, approvals)

**MoSCoW:** Must

---

### 4.5 Weekly Automated Reports (P1)

**User Story:** As a creator, I want a weekly summary of my performance delivered to my inbox so I can track progress without logging in.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Automated email every Monday at 9 AM user timezone
- [ ] Top performing posts with scores and metrics
- [ ] Week-over-week comparison
- [ ] AI-generated insights and recommendations
- [ ] Customizable metrics selection
- [ ] Unsubscribe option

**MoSCoW:** Should

---

### 4.6 API Access (P1)

**User Story:** As a developer/agency, I want API access to integrate Signal OS scoring into my workflow.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] RESTful API with authentication (API keys)
- [ ] Score endpoint with full dimension breakdown
- [ ] Rate limits by plan tier
- [ ] Webhook support for score completion
- [ ] Comprehensive documentation
- [ ] SDK for Node.js and Python

**MoSCoW:** Should

---

### 4.7 Mobile App (P2)

**User Story:** As a creator, I want to score and publish content from my phone so I can work on-the-go.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] iOS and Android apps
- [ ] Core scoring functionality
- [ ] Push notifications for scheduled posts
- [ ] Share extension to score from any app
- [ ] Offline score caching

**MoSCoW:** Could

## 5. Non-Functional Requirements

### 5.1 Performance

| Metric | Target | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Scoring latency (p50) | <200ms | Datadog APM |
| Scoring latency (p99) | <500ms | Datadog APM |
| Page load (LCP) | <2.5s | Vercel Analytics |
| API uptime | 99.9% | CloudWatch |
| Concurrent users | 5,000 | Load testing |

### 5.2 Security

| Requirement | Standard |
|-------------|----------|
| Authentication | JWT with 7-day expiry |
| Password storage | bcrypt cost 12 |
| Data encryption | AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit |
| API rate limiting | 100 req/min free, 1000 req/min pro |
| Compliance | GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 |

### 5.3 Accessibility

| Standard | Target |
|----------|--------|
| WCAG | 2.1 Level AA |
| Keyboard navigation | Full support |
| Screen reader | ARIA labels on all interactive elements |
| Color contrast | 4.5:1 minimum |

---

## 6. Success Metrics

### 6.1 North Star Metric
**Weekly Active Scorers (WAS)** — Users who score at least 1 piece of content per week.

### 6.2 Input Metrics

| Metric | Target | Tracking |
|--------|--------|----------|
| Activation rate | 60% | Product analytics |
| Score frequency | 10 scores/week per active user | Product analytics |
| Feature adoption (3+ features) | 40% | Product analytics |
| Onboarding completion | 90% | Product analytics |

### 6.3 Output Metrics

| Metric | Target | Tracking |
|--------|--------|----------|
| Free-to-paid conversion | 12% | Stripe + analytics |
| Monthly churn | <5% | Stripe + analytics |
| NPS | 40+ | Quarterly survey |
| Engagement improvement | 3x | User reporting |
